title: A monthly plan started on the 29th, 30th or 31st, or a yearly plan started on 29 Feb, gives the member up to 3 fewer days
what: When the desk sells a monthly plan, the last day is worked out as 'same day next month, minus one'. When next month is shorter, the day is first pulled back to that month's last day and then one more day is taken off. So monthly plans sold on 28, 29, 30 or 31 January all end on 27 February: the member who starts on 31 January pays the full month and gets 28 days, while one who starts on 28 January gets 31. The same happens before every 30-day month (31 March ends 29 April) and to a yearly plan sold on 29 February, which ends on 27 February the next year. A test locks this in as correct. The sell sheet shows the last day, but nothing says it is shorter than usual.
expected: A plan that starts on a day the next month does not have ends on the last day of that month (31 January ends 28 February, 29 February ends 28 February next year), so every member gets a full month for a full month's price.
how_often: every plan sold on a month-end day before a shorter month, and every yearly plan sold on 29 Feb
fix_line: When the start day does not exist in the end month, end on that month's last day instead of the day before it; the member app and server must use the same rule

items.reason: Web panel: no install package, sideload, watch or phone version split in these forms. The service worker uses the network first, so a fresh load always gets the newest forms. A desk tab left open across a deploy keeps the old forms and is never told to reload (same fault as FN-B-time-panel-assistant-01); the server still checks every money and member save, and its refusals are turned into words. Payments kept offline by an older page are sent by the newer one: payment, sale and push items are all still known; one refused later is FN-B-run-panel-forms-a-01. The offline receipt series is given to a device the first time a money sheet opens online, so an old device gets it too.

Month end and leap day: FN-B-time-panel-forms-01. Today is India's day and moves at midnight even in a tab left open. Year end: receipt numbers restart per financial year (April) and a back-dated receipt slots into its own year. Member leaves and returns: Restore from Add member loses typed details (FN-B-truth-panel-forms-a-01); the renewal starts today after a long gap, and the joining fee is not charged again, with a hint saying so (the owner can type one). Ended plan: Extra days says plainly if the plan is still ended. Trial or plan end: the lock is switched off today; once on, a read-only or basic gym's saves are refused with clear words naming Pay MettleUp. Staff leaves: the server checks each save's sign-in; offline saves refused later are FN-B-run-panel-forms-a-01. Owner changes phone, 6 months unopened: nothing in these forms keeps dates on the device besides the offline series, which is per financial year.

Flows added later: every-branch switch, pass members, desk camera photo, joining fee for members brought in from the old register, the offline receipt series, who took the money. None works only for new members: the switch and pass box are on Edit as well, a member brought in from the old register counts as having paid the fee, and the offline series is given to any device on its first online money sheet.
Path exists: existing members get a desk photo from their own page (Take photo), the every-branch box and the pass box from Edit, and What's new tells owners where the pass box is.
Rule applied: every later flow in these forms has a path for existing members, so no finding.

The forms show no new dots or badges ('+ New batch' only makes a batch). What's new shows nothing on a browser that never saw it: the first visit is remembered, not announced, so a brand-new gym sees no 'new' marks.
Rule applied: no new mark shows to a brand-new install, so no finding.
